title: What the Middleman Delivers: Answer Behavior, Tool Permissions, and Billed Usage in LLM API Relays
title_zh: 中间商交付了什么：大语言模型API中转中的回答行为、工具权限与计费用量

paragraphs.en: 研究测试20个LLM API中转，发现计费用量虚报与工具权限违规等可靠性风险。 Third-party application programming interface (API) relays offer access to large language models (LLMs), often at lower prices. Users depend on these services for model quality, instruction compliance, and accurate billing. However, existing studies leave unclear whether relays meet these expectations together. We test 20 relays offering GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5. First, we compare answers to knowledge questions with batch-matched official responses. In our first-round sample, the analysis flags 7/10 low-price and 2/10 same- or higher-price relays for behavioral differences. On retesting 35 pairs, seven gain or lose a flag under the original rules, and six under matched correction families. Because answer comparisons cannot reveal every delivery problem, we examine returned content and tool permissions. No injection is confirmed in 3,332 screened responses to a fixed, non-adversarial code and setup workload, yet four relays return tool calls despite instructions disabling them in the first round. Finally, to connect reported usage to actual costs, we compare input-token counts with official references and check balances. For identical requests, five relays report 4,200 to 60,000 more input tokens than the official API. Where balances are available (six services), charges follow reported usage at listed prices, including extra reported input tokens at one service. Our study shows that advertised models and prices are insufficient to judge relay reliability. It identifies unexplained billed token quantities and tool-permission violations as risks and shows why service evaluations need repeated measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 第三方应用程序接口（API）中转以通常更低的价格提供对大语言模型（LLM）的访问。 用户依赖这些服务来获得模型质量、指令遵从和准确的计费。 然而，现有研究尚未明确中转能否同时满足这些期望。 我们测试了20个提供GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5的中转。 首先，我们将知识问题的答案与批量匹配的官方回答进行比较。 在第一轮样本中，分析标记出7/10低价和2/10同价或更高价的中转存在行为差异。 在对35对样本进行复测时，按原始规则有7个中转新增或失去标记，按匹配的修正规则有6个。 由于答案比较无法揭示所有交付问题，我们检查了返回内容和工具权限。 在对一个固定的、非对抗性的代码与环境配置工作负载筛查的3,332条响应中，未确认任何注入，但在第一轮中仍有4个中转在指令禁用工具的情况下返回了工具调用。 最后，为了将报告的用量与实际成本关联起来，我们将输入token数与官方参考值进行比较，并核查余额。 对于完全相同的请求，5个中转报告的输入token比官方API多4,200至60,000个。 在余额可查的情况下（6个服务），费用按标价与报告用量一致，其中一家服务还按额外报告的输入token收费。 我们的研究表明，仅凭宣传的模型和价格不足以判断中转的可靠性。 研究将无法解释的计费token数量和工具权限违规识别为风险，并说明了服务评估为何需要重复测量。
